messages:
jessica: heads-up — Acme (raj) is pushing for DPA + SCCs and a clear DSAR/deletion flow before the POC. they want the paperwork + minimal SIG answers. POC kickoff next Wed; we need to assemble responses by EOD Mon.

mike: ack. can we scope the CAIQ to POC-only systems to speed up? most infra questions won't apply.

sara: @jessica can you confirm data categories involved? is there any PHI or sensitive healthcare data?

jessica: they said user messages, emails, account ids. explicitly no PHI. retention ask: 'close account -> delete all user content within 30 days'.

oliver: drafting language now. suggested DPA snippet: 
```
Deletion: On verified request, Redwood will delete Customer Data within 30 days. Exemptions: aggregated/anonymized metrics and minimal logs required for billing or fraud detection retained for up to 90 days.
```

mike: for POC we will implement delete as S3 lifecycle + purge model KV cache. sample config we can show them: 
```
storage:
  object_retention_days: 30
model_cache:
  purge_on_delete: true
```

sara: also note SCCs — we can provide the standard EU SCC addendum. need to include current subprocessors list (I will attach). also confirm encryption in transit/rest and KMS usage in the answers.

jessica: quick question for legal: can we agree to their "no retained training" requirement (i.e., not use customer content to train models)?

oliver: yes, we can include a no-training addendum. will add explicit line: "Redwood will not use Customer Content to train models without prior written consent."

mike: timeline risk: if these docs aren't handed off before Wed, Acme might delay the POC start. I'll prepare a minimal CAIQ subset with TBDs for internal ops items.

sara: i'll assemble a one-page security attestation covering: encryption (TLS + at-rest), KMS key ownership, RBAC, incident contact, and SOC/ISO certs.

jessica: perfect. i'll consolidate DPA snippet + SCCs + attestation + CAIQ subset and send to Raj Mon morning. cc @mike @sara @oliver :thumbsup:

sec-bot: note: shared doc created — /shared/sig-responses/acme-poc by jessica at 1769954325

oliver: one more ops ask — confirm we can provide a data export endpoint so customer can retrieve all user content before deletion. mike, can you add a simple export curl example?

mike: sure, sample export call: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/export -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"user_id":"abcd-1234"}'
```

jessica: nice. i'll include that in the response and propose the 30-day deletion SLA. thanks y'all — i'll send the email after oliver signs off on the DPA language. :rocket:
